scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia! Do you know Moscovia?
the paradise spreading on the endless seas...
Welcome to Moscovia
It's adventurous and mystic.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚！您听说过莫斯科比亚吗？
那是无尽海洋上的乐园...
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚，这里充满冒险与神秘。

scripts.text: About Moscovia...
scripts.translation: 关于莫斯科比亚...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 前往莫斯科比亚

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia is a beautiful kingdom
on an island located north of Rune-
Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚是个美丽的王国，坐落在卢恩·米德加兹北方的岛屿上。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sure that you will be
absolutely fascinated
by Moscovia's beautiful scenery
and gorgeous palace.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
相信莫斯科比亚的美景和壮丽的宫殿，一定会让您着迷。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Now that our long winter has
passed,
I'm happy that I can now show you
our gorgeous hometown.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
漫长的冬天终于过去了，很高兴能带您领略我们美丽的家乡。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you feel like visiting Moscovia
take the chance now!
I'll help you to have a nice trip
to Moscovia!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
想去莫斯科比亚的话，现在正是好时候！
我会帮您安排一趟愉快的旅程！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, let us start now.
You should pay me 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia.
But when you come back,
you don't have to pay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好，那就准备出发吧。
前往莫斯科比亚需要支付10,000 Zeny，返程免费。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Can we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我们现在可以出发了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果现在没空，想出发时再来找我就好。
我随时可以带您前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sorry but you don't have
enough zeny now
You need 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
很抱歉，您现在的Zeny不足。
前往莫斯科比亚需要10,000 Zeny。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, we're leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，我们现在出发了。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果现在没空，想出发时再来找我就好。
我随时可以带您前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
How was your trip?
Do you have good memories from Moscovia?
A ship is now leaving
for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
旅途怎么样？
在莫斯科比亚留下美好的回忆了吗？
现在有一艘船即将返回卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text: Return to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you want to see more
please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
还想再逛逛的话，就慢慢欣赏吧。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Please come and visit soon.
Ok then, Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
欢迎您不久后再来。
好，出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Our dear Csar Alexsay III is in the palace.
He rules over Moscovia.
Please be careful not to cause him any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
统治莫斯科比亚的沙皇亚历克赛三世，就在宫殿里。
请注意，别给陛下添麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please be silent or the Csar will be angry.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
请保持安静，否则沙皇会生气的。
